messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: planning a minimal base-image rebuild to remove setuid helpers and trim xz-utils. Target Fri 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need RBAC scope change and audit hooks.

mira: I'll scope image-baker SA to namespace-only and grant storage.objects.create + iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob. No cluster-admin. Drafting YAML.

sec-oncall: Ensure the bake pipeline emits structured audit JSON: actor, action=bake, image_sha, key_id, audit_trace_id. Forward to audit tenant.

build-bot: scheduled job jb-9009 for 2026-05-07T01:00:00Z. Alerts to #eng-runtime.

ops: Rollback plan: keep previous signed image digest, run a 5% canary for 10 minutes, run smoke tests (GET /health, p90 < 300ms). Failure -> auto-revert routing and preserve artifacts.

alex: OK. Please get RBAC PR merged 48h before window and smoke tests green in staging. Reconvene Tue 14:00 UTC for final preflight.
